description:
Welcome to the release of MKR MUSIC! 🎉

Crafted with a completely overhauled User Interface alongside massive underlying optimizations. Featuring instant playback streaming, delayed background caching, granular search, and Material 3 Expressive aesthetics.

Please check out our Release Notes.

changelog.title: Playback & Streaming Engine
items: Instant Playback Start: Direct low-latency streaming pipeline bypassing pre-caching buffer delays for instantaneous audio playback.
Configurable Delayed Caching: New Storage & Cache setting allowing background caching only after continuous listening (slider 5s–90s, default 10s).
Decoupled Background Cache: CacheWriter runs quietly on background IO without affecting active playback threads.

changelog.title: User Interface & Experience
items: Chainsaw Spikes Support Button: Custom-designed animated moving chainsaw teeth border on Donate & Support button.
Direct UPI Copy Card: One-tap copy for UPI ID with tactile spring feedback.
Rotating Gratitude Appreciation: Random gratitude appreciation toasts on copy with 4-second dismiss.
Granular Settings Search: Indexes sub-options and granular keywords (e.g. searching 'hide') with zero duplicate results.
Simplified Update Flow: Direct GitHub Releases link with step-by-step backup and manual installation guidance.
Balanced Onboarding Hero: Centered MKR Music logo with tagline 'Welcome to the world of music' and elegant developer badge.

changelog.title: Support the Project
changelog.description: MKR Music will always remain free and open-source. If you enjoy the countless hours poured into this app, consider supporting the development below ❤️️
